nodes.Name: unsafe
nodes.DocComment: for go:linkname

nodes.Name: Source
nodes.DocComment:
A Source is a source of uniformly-distributed
pseudo-random uint64 values in the range [0, 1<<64).

A Source is not safe for concurrent use by multiple goroutines.

nodes.Name: Rand
nodes.DocComment: A Rand is a source of random numbers.

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment:
New returns a new Rand that uses random values from src
to generate other random values.

nodes.Name: Int64
nodes.DocComment: Int64 returns a non-negative pseudo-random 63-bit integer as an int64.

nodes.Name: Uint32
nodes.DocComment: Uint32 returns a pseudo-random 32-bit value as a uint32.

nodes.Name: Uint64
nodes.DocComment: Uint64 returns a pseudo-random 64-bit value as a uint64.

nodes.Name: Int32
nodes.DocComment: Int32 returns a non-negative pseudo-random 31-bit integer as an int32.

nodes.Name: Int
nodes.DocComment: Int returns a non-negative pseudo-random int.

nodes.Name: Uint
nodes.DocComment: Uint returns a pseudo-random uint.

nodes.Name: Int64N
nodes.DocComment:
Int64N returns, as an int64, a non-negative pseudo-random number in the half-open interval [0,n).
It panics if n <= 0.

nodes.Name: Uint64N
nodes.DocComment:
Uint64N returns, as a uint64, a non-negative pseudo-random number in the half-open interval [0,n).
It panics if n == 0.

nodes.Name: uint64n
nodes.DocComment: uint64n is the no-bounds-checks version of Uint64N.

nodes.Name: uint32n
nodes.DocComment:
uint32n is an identical computation to uint64n
but optimized for 32-bit systems.

nodes.Name: Int32N
nodes.DocComment:
Int32N returns, as an int32, a non-negative pseudo-random number in the half-open interval [0,n).
It panics if n <= 0.

nodes.Name: Uint32N
nodes.DocComment:
Uint32N returns, as a uint32, a non-negative pseudo-random number in the half-open interval [0,n).
It panics if n == 0.

nodes.Name: IntN
nodes.DocComment:
IntN returns, as an int, a non-negative pseudo-random number in the half-open interval [0,n).
It panics if n <= 0.

nodes.Name: UintN
nodes.DocComment:
UintN returns, as a uint, a non-negative pseudo-random number in the half-open interval [0,n).
It panics if n == 0.

nodes.Name: Float64
nodes.DocComment: Float64 returns, as a float64, a pseudo-random number in the half-open interval [0.0,1.0).

nodes.Name: Float32
nodes.DocComment: Float32 returns, as a float32, a pseudo-random number in the half-open interval [0.0,1.0).

nodes.Name: Perm
nodes.DocComment:
Perm returns, as a slice of n ints, a pseudo-random permutation of the integers
in the half-open interval [0,n).

nodes.Name: Shuffle
nodes.DocComment:
Shuffle pseudo-randomizes the order of elements.
n is the number of elements. Shuffle panics if n < 0.
swap swaps the elements with indexes i and j.

nodes.Name: globalRand
nodes.DocComment:
globalRand is the source of random numbers for the top-level
convenience functions.

nodes.Name: runtime_rand
nodes.DocComment: go:linkname runtime_rand runtime.rand

nodes.Name: runtimeSource
nodes.DocComment: runtimeSource is a Source that uses the runtime fastrand functions.

from the default Source.

nodes.Name: Uint32

nodes.DocComment:

The type parameter Int can be any integer type.

nodes.Name: Float64

nodes.Name: Float32
nodes.DocComment:

nodes.Name: Perm
nodes.DocComment:

in the half-open interval [0,n) from the default Source.

nodes.Name: Shuffle
nodes.DocComment:
Shuffle pseudo-randomizes the order of elements using the default Source.
n is the number of elements. Shuffle panics if n < 0.
swap swaps the elements with indexes i and j.

nodes.Name: NormFloat64
nodes.DocComment:
NormFloat64 returns a normally distributed float64 in the range
[-math.MaxFloat64, +math.MaxFloat64] with
standard normal distribution (mean = 0, stddev = 1)
from the default Source.
To produce a different normal distribution, callers can
adjust the output using:

	sample = NormFloat64() * desiredStdDev + desiredMean

nodes.Name: ExpFloat64
nodes.DocComment:
ExpFloat64 returns an exponentially distributed float64 in the range
(0, +math.MaxFloat64] with an exponential distribution whose rate parameter
(lambda) is 1 and whose mean is 1/lambda (1) from the default Source.
To produce a distribution with a different rate parameter,
callers can adjust the output using:

	sample = ExpFloat64() / desiredRateParameter
